Country.evidence_source: Participation was limited to U.K. citizens of adult age, so as to achieve a relatively homogeneous sample in terms of cultural and national identity.

Survey method.evidence_source: Data were collected via the Prolific Academic Web site, a crowdsourcing Internet marketplace that allows individuals to complete academic surveys for monetary compensation, between November 8th and 11th, 2016.

Source of sample.evidence_source: Data were collected via the Prolific Academic Web site, a crowdsourcing Internet marketplace that allows individuals to complete academic surveys for monetary compensation.

Number of studies.evidence_source: Procedure describes a single data collection carried out between November 8th and 11th, 2016, with no mention of multiple separate studies.

section_summary.extract_value: This Procedure section reports that the study received university ethics approval and data were collected online via the Prolific Academic platform between November 8 and 11, 2016. Participation was restricted to U.K. adult citizens, measures were presented anonymously with counterbalanced order (demographics last), participants were paid £1.00, and debriefing was provided; there is no mention of multiple studies or sample size.
section_summary.evidence_source: The project was approved by the relevant university ethics committee (approval number: ETH1617-0014). Data were collected via the Prolific Academic Web site, a crowdsourcing Internet marketplace ... between November 8th and 11th, 2016. Participation was limited to U.K. citizens of adult age... The order of presentation of each of the scales above was counterbalanced for each participant, although the request for demographic details always appeared last. In exchange for completing the survey, participants were paid £1.00, and all participants received debriefing information at the end of the survey.
